Trace, implement and test: leetcode949 largest time for given digits next permutation

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    string largestTimeFromDigits(vector<int>& A) {
        string res = "";
        sort(A.begin(), A.end());
        do
        {
            if ((A[0] == 2 && A[1] <= 3 || A[0] < 2) && A[2] <= 5)
            {
                string curTime = to_string(A[0]) + to_string(A[1]) + ":"
                    + to_string(A[2])+to_string(A[3]);
                if (curTime > res) res = curTime;
            }       
        } while (next_permutation(A.begin(), A.end()));
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {2, 0, 6, 6};
    auto res = sol.largestTimeFromDigits(nums);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
